newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Aquila cut to hold, stock off.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Aquila cut to hold, stock off.

text.p: Jefferies & Co Inc analyst Lawrence Crowley cut the firm's rating of Aquila Gas Pipeline Corp to hold from buy on Wednesday.
-- stock fell 10/16 to 11-15/16 and touched a new year-low of 11-7/8.
-- said Q2 EPS of $0.24 posted late Tuesday came in just a penny under estimate of $0.25 a share. Aquila earned $0.26 a share last year.

-- In a report, Crowley cited a shift in fundamentals, saying system July Austin Chalk throughput volumes have deteriorated, which could cut into earnings over the next 18 months. Also saw no immediate recovery in sight.
